9
A whale dives to a depth of 3000m in sea water.
In addition to the gravitational field strength, which variables determine the pressure on the whale
due to the water at a depth of 3000m?
A
depth, water density and mass of the whale only
B
depth and water density only
C
depth, surface area of the whale and mass of the whale only
D
depth and surface area of the whale only

options.label: A
options.text: depth, water density and mass of the whale only

options.label: C
options.text: depth, surface area of the whale and mass of the whale only

options.label: D
options.text: depth and surface area of the whale only
